name: xn-qol-enhancements
author: Xnuui
description:
[#FFB7C5]Features in this mod were listed as [#EF4444]PRs[][#FFB7C5] a while ago. But [#EF4444]Anuke[][#FFB7C5], to this day, has not decided to merge them in, so i made a mod about it.[]

[#EF4444]Features included:[]

1. [#FFF000]Phase Bridge Auto-link [#EF4444](DRAGGING)[]
[#88C6ED]Works like normal bridges when you drag, but with phase bridges supported too.[]

2. [#FFF000]Junction Fix[]
[#88C6ED]Lets players move a conduit line over a junction without turning it back into a normal conduit.[]

3. [#82C341]Total Schematic Fix[]
[#88C6ED]Displays the total schematic size when opening a schematic.[]

4. [#FAA31B]Heat Decimal Display[]
[#88C6ED]Displays heat as a decimal only when there is one (1.5 stays 1.5, 3 stays 3).[]
